paragraphs.text:
Albert Einstein is perhaps the best-known scientist of the 20th century. He received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1921 and his theories of special and general relativity are of great importance to many branches of physics and astronomy. He is well known for his theories about light, matter, gravity, space and time. His most famous idea is that energy and mass are different forms of the same thing.

Einstein was born in Württemberg, Germany, on 14 March 1879. His family was Jewish, but he was not very religious in his youth, although he became very interested in Judaism later in life.
paragraphs.translation:
Albert Einstein 或許是二十世紀最著名的科學家。他於 1921 年獲得諾貝爾物理學獎，而他的狹義與廣義相對論，對物理學和天文學的許多分支都極為重要。他以研究光、物質、重力、空間和時間的理論而聞名。他最著名的觀點是：能量與質量其實是同一事物的不同形式。

Einstein 於 1879 年 3 月 14 日在德國符騰堡出生。他出身於猶太家庭；年輕時宗教信仰並不濃厚，但後來對猶太教產生了濃厚興趣。

paragraphs.text: It is well documented that Einstein did not begin speaking until after the age of three. In fact, he found speaking so difficult that his family were worried that he would never start to speak. When Einstein was four years old, his father gave him a magnetic compass. It was this compass that inspired him to explore the world of science. He wanted to understand why the needle always pointed north whichever way he turned the compass. It looked as if the needle was moving by itself. But the needle was inside a closed case, so no other force (such as the wind) could have been moving it. And this is how Einstein became interested in studying science and mathematics.
paragraphs.translation: 有充分記錄顯示，Einstein 三歲以後才開始說話。事實上，他覺得說話非常困難，家人甚至擔心他永遠不會開口。Einstein 四歲時，父親送給他一個磁性羅盤。正是這個羅盤啟發他探索科學世界。無論他把羅盤轉向哪一方，指針總是指向北方；他很想明白箇中原因。指針看來像是在自行轉動。然而，指針位於封閉的外殼內，因此不可能有其他力量（例如風）推動它。Einstein 就這樣開始對科學和數學產生興趣。

paragraphs.text: In fact, he was so clever that at the age of 12 he taught himself Euclidean geometry. At 15, he went to a school in Munich, which he found very boring. He finished secondary school in Aarau, Switzerland and entered the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Zurich from which he graduated in 1900. But Einstein did not like the teaching there either. He often missed classes and used the time to study physics on his own or to play the violin instead. However, he was able to pass his examinations by studying the notes of a classmate. His teachers did not have a good opinion of him and refused to recommend him for a university position. So, he got a job in a patent office in Switzerland. While he was working there, he wrote the papers that first made him famous as a great scientist.
paragraphs.translation: 事實上，他聰明得在十二歲時便自學歐幾里得幾何。十五歲時，他入讀慕尼黑一所學校，卻覺得課堂非常沉悶。他在瑞士阿勞完成中學，之後入讀蘇黎世的瑞士聯邦理工學院，並於 1900 年畢業。不過，Einstein 同樣不喜歡那裡的教學。他經常缺課，把時間用來自行研習物理或拉小提琴。然而，他靠研讀同學的筆記，仍能通過考試。老師對他的評價不高，並拒絕推薦他擔任大學職位。因此，他在瑞士一所專利局任職。工作期間，他寫下首批令自己以傑出科學家之名聲名大噪的論文。

paragraphs.text: Two of Einstein’s children with his first wife, Mileva, had serious health conditions. His daughter (whose name we do not know) was born in January 1902, about a year before their marriage. She was looked after by her Serbian grandparents until she died at the age of two. It is generally believed that she died from scarlet fever but there are those who believe that she may have suffered from a disorder known as Down syndrome. However, there is not enough evidence to know for sure. In fact, no one even knew that she had existed until Einstein’s granddaughter found 54 love letters that Einstein and Mileva had written to each other between 1897 and 1903. She found these letters inside a shoebox in their attic in California. Einstein and Mileva’s son, Eduard, was diagnosed with schizophrenia. He spent decades in hospitals and died in Zurich in 1965.
paragraphs.translation: Einstein 與第一任妻子 Mileva 所生的兩名孩子，都有嚴重健康問題。他們的女兒（名字至今不詳）於 1902 年 1 月出生，約在二人結婚前一年。她由塞爾維亞籍祖父母照顧，兩歲時去世。一般相信她死於猩紅熱，但也有人認為她可能患有唐氏綜合症；然而，證據不足，無法確定。事實上，直至 Einstein 的孫女發現 Einstein 與 Mileva 在 1897 至 1903 年間互寫的 54 封情書，世人才知道這名女兒曾經存在。她在加州家中閣樓的一個鞋盒內發現這些信件。Einstein 與 Mileva 的兒子 Eduard 被診斷患有精神分裂症。他在醫院度過數十年，並於 1965 年在蘇黎世去世。

paragraphs.text: Just before the start of World War I, Einstein moved back to Germany and became director of a school there. But in 1933, following death threats from the Nazis, he moved to the United States, where he died on 18 April 1955.
paragraphs.translation: 第一次世界大戰爆發前夕，Einstein 搬回德國，並擔任當地一所學校的主管。然而，1933 年，在受到納粹死亡威脅後，他移居美國，最後於 1955 年 4 月 18 日在當地去世。

questions.prompt: The general theory of relativity is a very important theory in modern physics.
questions.translation: 廣義相對論是現代物理學中非常重要的理論。

questions.prompt: Einstein had such difficulty with language that those around him thought he would never learn how to speak.
questions.translation: Einstein 在語言方面有很大困難，以至於身邊的人以為他永遠不會學會說話。

questions.prompt: It seemed to Einstein that nothing could be pushing the needle of the compass around except the wind.
questions.translation: 在 Einstein 看來，除了風之外，似乎沒有任何東西能推動羅盤指針轉動。

questions.prompt: Einstein enjoyed the teaching methods in Switzerland.
questions.translation: Einstein 喜歡瑞士的教學方法。

questions.prompt: Einstein taught himself how to play the violin.
His daughter died of schizophrenia when she was two.
questions.translation: 他的女兒兩歲時死於精神分裂症。

questions.prompt: The existence of a daughter only became known to the world between 1897 and 1903.
questions.translation: 女兒的存在只是在 1897 至 1903 年之間才為世人所知。

questions.prompt: In 1933, Einstein moved to the United States where he became an American citizen.
questions.translation: 1933 年，Einstein 移居美國，並在那裡成為美國公民。

questions.prompt: He tried hard to understand how the needle could seem to move by itself so that it always ______.
questions.translation: 他努力想理解指針為何看似自己移動，並且總是 ______。

questions.translation: 他經常不上課，並把時間用來 ______ 學物理，或去演奏音樂。
